title: Fix the Wrong Exception Catch
description: The program should catch division-by-zero errors and print a friendly message. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 'Cannot divide by zero' instead of crashing when dividing by zero.
actualProblem: Dividing by zero raises a ZeroDivisionError, not a ValueError, so the except clause doesn't match and the exception propagates uncaught, crashing the program.
explanation: An except clause only catches the specific exception type (or its parent types) that it names. Catching ValueError does nothing to intercept a ZeroDivisionError, since they are unrelated exception classes.
